items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: And Cecil Taylor, Bill Dixon and Carla Bley and Paul Bley, and different people like that. They started that October Revolution

ctx.x: That was one of the beginnings of it, you know, like Cecil Taylor and Bill Dixon and because I was playing with Bill Dixon at that time. And Cecil Taylor, Bill Dixon and Carla Bley and Paul Bley, and different people like that. They started that October Revolution, actually Bill Dixon was one of the main things in that. And then they got the JOC thing too, which started a record distributing company and so that encouraged people to make their own records and JVC, uh, not JVC, JCOA.
